description:
**§22 SMOKE GATE: CLEARED — 2026-05-26**
All §22 must-pass scripted rows PASS on HEAD `d335a09`. ISS-020/021/022/023 resolved. VAL-CAP-004, VAL-EXP-010, VAL-EXP-012, VAL-REG-002 green. No active deterministic regressions. Remaining §23 RC suite, §18 coverage gate, §21 comparison, §16 regression suite scope is active but not stabilization-blocked. See handover `2026-05-25-07-t-010c-s22-gate-cleared.md`.

---

Execute the v2.0.0 validation matrix and produce the release-gate verdict against N-008 §24 items 1–7.

**T-010c was BLOCKED until the v2 implementation series (T-011..T-021) reached a runnable RC candidate.** Per the 2026-05-13 implementation split (handover `2026-05-13-12-v2-implementation-ticket-split.md`), the v2 native/helper replay engine does not yet exist. T-010c only becomes executable once:
- T-011..T-019 land the helper crate, JSON-RPC transport, Electron supervisor, preload/renderer surface, simulator, PipeWire capture MVP, NVENC+libx264 encoder MVP, rolling fMP4 segment buffer MVP, and stream-copy export MVP.
- T-020 lands the renderer FSM/diagnostics surface so the v2 path is the user-visible default.
- T-021 runs the MVP smoke subset on M1 and returns a `green` "Ready for T-010c" verdict.

Execution plan (binding, after the implementation gate clears):
1. Smoke suite (N-008 §22) on M1. 18 ordered rows; stop on first must-pass red. Wall time budget ≤ 30 min including manual interactions on M1+M5.
2. RC suite (N-008 §23) on M1+M2+M3+M4 mandatory; M5 for manual rows; W1 documentation only (no Windows release in v2.0.0). Wall time budget 4–6 hours dominated by the 15-min soak rows at 1080p60/1440p60/4K60 × 3 encoder paths.
3. Resolution × encoder coverage gate (N-008 §18). Every must-pass cell green: 1080p60 × {NVENC, VAAPI, QSV, libx264}; 1440p60 × {NVENC, VAAPI, QSV}; 4K60 × {NVENC, VAAPI, QSV}. 4K60 libx264 nice-to-have with back-pressure mandatory; AMF and WGC inert (VAL-ENC-012).
4. v1.1.0 regression suite (N-008 §16, VAL-REG-001..013). Every row green. Note VAL-REG-005 (audio sidecar) is `must-pass-when-audio` only — does NOT gate v2.0.0 video-only GA.
5. Issue #1/#3/#4 absorption proofs (N-008 §17). Triple-classified must-pass + smoke + regression rows green.
6. v1.1.0 vs v2.0.0 comparison plot (N-008 §21). Run L-MOTION-60 on both for each resolution × encoder cell. Record drops, frame count vs declared fps, save latency, HUD freeze duration. v1.1.0 expected to fail 1440p/4K and freeze on save. v2.0.0 must clear all. Discipline: if v2.0.0 regresses below v1.1.0 at 1080p60, that is a hard fail even if within absolute tolerance.
7. Diagnostics bundle (N-008 §7) collected for at least one passing run per encoder path. Verify the redaction rule from N-007 §16 (paths above the recording redacted) — itself VAL-DIAG-002.

Deliverable: a release-candidate report containing
- Per-row pass/fail with evidence references (the JSON report from T-010a's harness).
- §18 coverage-gate matrix marked green/red per cell × machine.
- v1.1.0 vs v2.0.0 comparison plot.
- A red/green verdict against N-008 §24 items 1–7. Items 8–9 belong to T-010d; item 10 belongs to T-010e.
- A list of any nice-to-have reds, filed as tracked post-GA storybloq issues per the §24 footnote.

Dependencies (binding):
- Blocked by T-010a (runner harness must be able to drive the scripted-local rows and produce the per-row report).
- Blocked by T-010b (synthetic loads must exist).
- Blocked by T-021 (v2 implementation MVP must produce a `green` smoke verdict on M1; without a real helper, runner+loads have nothing to drive).
- Runs in parallel with T-010d (packaging audit). The two outputs combine into the §24 final checklist that T-010e gates on.

Failure handling:
- A must-pass red blocks GA. Open a storybloq issue, link it to the failing row(s) and owner_on_fail layer (capture / encoder / segment / export / ui / supervision / packaging) per N-008 §3, and stop. T-010c re-opens after the fix.
- A nice-to-have red is filed as a tracked post-GA issue and does NOT block GA.
- A regression red against v1.1.0 at 1080p60 (per §21 discipline) is a hard fail even if absolute thresholds are met.

Out of scope (binding):
- Building the runner harness (T-010a) or the synthetic loads (T-010b).
- Building any v2 implementation code (T-011..T-021).
- Packaging audit / electron-builder / sha256 sidecars / .deb Depends (T-010d).
- Release publish, version bump, CHANGELOG, tag/push (T-010e).
- Any source-code changes to the helper or Electron app. If a row fails because of a defect, T-010c files the issue and pauses; the fix is a separate ticket against the owner_on_fail layer.
- Windows hardware (W1 placeholder).
- Audio gating.
- 4K60 success claim — N-008 is an acceptance plan, not a guarantee. A 4K60 must-pass red blocks GA per §18; the response is to fix the underlying layer or to re-scope the GA cut, not to massage the matrix.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.

**Blocking issues (2026-05-22):** ISS-008 (no v2 UI callers for region/encoder/hotkey surfaces), ISS-009 (recovery gate blocks Start under v2 UI), ISS-011 (VAL-CAP-006 frame-count deficit under SHM fallback), ISS-012 (export FSM stuck in EXPORTING after valid output), ISS-013 (renderer misses initial engine.ready, stuck in BOOTING). All five had to clear before §22 smoke rows were reachable; §22 is now cleared.
